jessica (Support): FYI customer (AcmeCorp) reports OAuth login failing when initiated from their mobile app webview. They hit a 400 / 'state_mismatch' on callback. Repro steps + logs below.

devon (Eng): Can you paste the exact callback URL the customer is getting and the error log? Also which provider (GitHub/Google)?

jessica (Support): GitHub. Customer flow: in-app webview hits our /auth/start -> GitHub -> redirect back to app via deeplink `acme://oauth/callback?state=Z2...` but they sometimes arrive with state truncated or empty. Example reported redirect: `acme://oauth/callback?code=abcd1234&state=` (empty) or `acme://oauth/callback?code=abcd1234&state=eyJhbGciOi...` (truncated). Server logs: `auth-bot: oauth: state mismatch: expected "eyJhbGciOiJI...", got "" (ticket #SUP-3298)`.

oliver (Infra): Any chance our proxy/load-balancer is rewriting Location headers on the 302 back to the deeplink? Some LB rules strip long querystrings or normalize `+` to space.

sanjay (SRE): Also seeing patterns where CDN (we use FastEdge) trims query after certain separators when redirecting to custom schemes. If the state contains `+` characters they sometimes get converted to spaces unless percent-encoded.

devon (Eng): Hmm. Two hypotheses: (1) PKCE/state value is too long and gets chunked/truncated by the mobile app/webview or an intermediate proxy; (2) plus/space encoding issue: `+` becoming space when not percent-encoded.

jessica (Support): Repro steps provided by customer: 1) Open Acme mobile app (iOS, embedded WKWebView) 2) Tap Connect -> opens GitHub auth page 3) Accept -> returns to deeplink `acme://oauth/callback?code=...&state=<long_b64>` 4) App receives callback but our backend logs state empty and returns 400. Happens intermittently (~20% of attempts).

devon (Eng): Can you ask them to capture the full redirect URL including raw bytes? If they can't, ask them to try in Safari (system browser) — if it works there it points to the webview. Also request UA, iOS version, and any network middleboxes (corporate VPN/proxy).

jessica (Support): Sent that checklist to customer. They replied: reproduces only in embedded webview on iOS 16.7, Safari flow works.

devon (Eng): That nails webview. Two mitigations: - Short-term: server-side fallback: if state missing, try cookie-based state (if cookie present and matches session) or return a friendly deep-link fallback to retry in external browser. - Long-term: improve tolerant parsing: accept both `%2B` and `+` and normalize whitespace, and log raw Location header.

oliver (Infra): I'll check our proxy rules for Location header cutting. Sanjay, can you grep edge logs around ticket SUP-3298 for any Location header truncation / 302 rewrite?

sanjay (SRE): On it. Found an entry where Location header length was 512 and our rewrite module truncated at 256. Key snippet: `proxy-rewrite: truncating Location header, uid=acme-conn-72, len=512 -> 256`.

devon (Eng): There we go. Proxy truncation + long base64 state -> state dropped. Proposed fix: update proxy config to preserve full Location header for OAuth endpoints and add a test that simulates deeplink redirect with long query params.

jessica (Support): Customer asked for ETA and a workaround — they need immediate fix.

devon (Eng): Short-term workaround options to give customer: 1) Use external browser (works) 2) Have them shorten state (not ideal) 3) We can enable cookie-based state fallback for their org (requires config and a quick feature flag roll to support org-scoped fallback). I can do (3) as a hotfix behind a flag.

oliver (Infra): I'll open infra PR to stop truncation for Location on routes matching /auth/redirect and add an allowlist. If we push a config change, rollback is simple.

devon (Eng): I'll prepare a small backend patch to check cookie-state when query param missing and gate it with feature flag `oauth_state_cookie_fallback`. Will add unit tests and a canary.

sanjay (SRE): Priority: P1 for customer impact. I'll surface to on-call and monitor rollout.

jessica (Support): Thanks — I'll tell Acme to expect a targeted hotfix in ~6 hours and a proxy config change in ~24 hours. Also gave them the external-browser workaround for now.

devon (Eng): Action items: - DEV-1142: add cookie-state fallback (owner: devon) - INF-880: Location-header allowlist (owner: oliver) - MON-512: synthetic test for deeplink length (owner: sanjay). Adding links to PRs when available.

jessica (Support): Pushed update to ticket SUP-3298 with workplan and ETA. Customer is happy with the workaround for now :thumbsup:.
